numbering: Season 1 episodes numbered 1-12; the Reze Arc film follows episode 12 and has no episode number (Anime Filler Guide numbering).

arcs.name: Introduction / Bat Devil
arcs.summary: Denji, a broke teen paying off his dead father's yakuza debt by hunting devils, merges with his chainsaw-devil dog Pochita and is recruited into Public Safety by the mysterious Makima.
events: Pochita fuses with a murdered Denji, turning him into the Chainsaw Man.
Denji is paired with Aki Hayakawa and the blood fiend Power.
Denji saves Power and her cat Meowy from the Bat Devil.

arcs.name: Eternity Devil
arcs.summary: On a mission to kill a piece of the Gun Devil, Makima's special division is trapped inside a hotel by a devil that demands Denji be handed over.
events: Himeno gives Denji his first kiss, and it goes badly.
Denji fights the Eternity Devil for three days straight and wins.
Denji learns the Gun Devil killed Aki's family.

arcs.name: Katana Man
arcs.summary: A coordinated ambush hits Public Safety, and Denji and Aki must train harder to strike back at the attackers who want Denji's heart.
events: Himeno dies giving herself to the Ghost Devil to save Aki.
Makima kills the yakuza-backed attackers from far away.
Denji and Aki defeat the Katana Man together.

arcs.name: Reze Arc
arcs.summary: Denji falls for Reze, a girl he meets at a café who seems to like him back, just as a new danger turns up in the city.
events: Reze is revealed to be the Bomb Hybrid, sent to steal Denji's heart.
Denji beats Reze in a brutal fight that wrecks the city.
Reze decides to run away with Denji but is killed by Makima before she can meet him.

filler.note: No filler: every episode and the film adapt the manga.
